brand_notes: Signature upgrade of 805 D4 (crossover, motor, top plate, grille); $14,000 (was $13,500 at Stereophile 2024, $12,000 at SSU 2025). Three independent measurements agree on dished response and low-4 ohm min impedance with EPDR ~2 ohm; claimed 88 dB sensitivity only met on B-weighted tweeter axis (stereophile-*) vs 84.1 NRC / 86.1 HFN. Stereophile heard hardening with NAD M10 (current-hungry load).
takeaways: Three Tier A/B sources: sens 84.1 (NRC) / 86.1 (HFN) / 88.4 B-weighted (Stereophile)
Min impedance 4.5-4.7 ohm, EPDR 2.0-2.1 ohm: demanding load, below-iec
f6 41 Hz; treble peak 9-10 kHz, HFN 8 dB mid dip, axial error ±4.9 dB
Stereophile: uncoloured mids but needs setup/system care; SSU: pure midrange, rising treble
No user reports found; B&W US stock form, retailers mixed
